Name: Checkout error taxonomy and instrumentation
Description: Make checkout failures measurable by normalizing reason codes and emitting checkout_error events.
Checklist: - [ ] Every checkout failure has a reason code; - [ ] Admin shows ranked error causes for last 7 days

Name: Checkout mobile layout optimization
Description: Reduce mobile drop-off by improving spacing, stacking, and CTA visibility.
Checklist: - [ ] No clipped content or overlapping controls on tested widths; - [ ] Mobile completion improves from Week 1 baseline

Name: Fee breakdown readability pass
Description: Improve confidence and comprehension in pricing summary with clearer label hierarchy.
Checklist: - [ ] Users identify net amount quickly in usability pass; - [ ] No terminology mismatch between checkout and admin

Name: Projection copy and assumption consistency audit
Description: Ensure scenario-based return language and assumption controls are consistent across surfaces.
Checklist: - [ ] No fixed-return language remains; - [ ] Assumption help text matches across pages

Name: CTA hierarchy refactor on fund/dashboard mobile
Description: De-crowd action controls by grouping secondary actions and preserving primary action clarity.
Checklist: - [ ] Primary action is always obvious; - [ ] Tap misfires reduced in QA walkthrough

Name: UX copy standardization (errors + confirmations)
Description: Standardize confirmation and error language and remove technical backend phrasing.
Checklist: - [ ] Copy review passes for touched flows; - [ ] No raw backend error strings shown to end users

Name: Stripe checkout preflight endpoint
Description: Add preflight validation to prevent avoidable checkout session failures.
Checklist: - [ ] Invalid requests fail preflight instead of checkout creation; - [ ] Frontend shows specific remediation message

Name: Baseline conversion dashboard and report
Description: Publish weekly conversion scorecard with starts, completes, failure reasons, and device split.
Checklist: - [ ] Week 2 scorecard published and repeatable; - [ ] Rates tie back to tracked events
